title: Creator Anchor
description: Experimental (media_buy.social_profiles). A place the creator controls that confirms the operator's sales-authorization claim. A confirmed anchor makes the claim mutually attested. The evaluator checks the anchor with its own request, as the verify_brand_claim two-calls rule does for brand claims. It never relies on the issuer's statement that the anchor holds. The one defined type is platform_profile_text. An anchor the evaluator cannot check, including one of a type it does not know, leaves the credential operator-attested, not invalid.

type.description: The kind of anchor. platform_profile_text is a line of text in the account's public profile. An evaluator treats a type it does not know as unconfirmed.

url.description: For platform_profile_text. HTTPS URL of the account's public profile page. It MUST be the profile address built from the subject's identifier, as the security documentation defines for youtube_channel_id, tiktok_id and instagram_handle. No address is built from an instagram_account_id, so an anchor for that subject is unconfirmed.

expected.description: For platform_profile_text. Text the creator placed in the profile. It MUST contain the issuer brand's domain. The evaluator confirms that the page at url contains this exact string.
